text:
anne: Quick sweep for GA tomorrow morning. We need explicit owners for SLA table, pricing examples, oncall rota, monitoring smoke, docs handoff, and post-launch watch. Who picks which?

miguel: I can take pricing doc and examples. Will add FinOps notes and per-route cost calc. ETA: EOD today.

lisa: I'll do a FinOps sanity check on the unit cost assumptions and add a sample billing CSV schema.

samir: Eng will own monitoring smoke and runbook skeleton. Plan: run a 5 qps soak in staging, sample traces, verify error budget burn and fallback behavior. Can run in ~2 hours.

jo: Oncall rota updated in the playbook; need someone for weekend standby (Sat 09:00-17:00 UTC). Also need contact details for escalation.

anne: For weekend: miguel primary, samir backup? Also confirm phone/email in playbook.

miguel: I can do primary.

samir: I'll be backup.

anne: SLA draft currently: 99.9% uptime for hosted endpoints; latency targets P50 100ms, P95 250ms. @jo can we commit?

jo: SLOs look ok but P95 250ms should have caveat: "for requests <=512 tokens". For long sequences add fallback path and documented expectation. Also advise adding regional variance note.

anne: Good. Miguel, add token-length caveat to pricing examples.

miguel: Will do. Also request: billing CSV needs token-level columns. Lisa, can you confirm fields?

lisa: Suggest CSV columns: customer_id, route, model_variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_usd, timestamp, region. I'll add sample file to docs.

build: ok
smoke: running

anne: Docs checklist: landing page, troubleshooting FAQ, runbook, and quickstart. Product writes troubleshooting and landing page, eng writes runbook. Who does quickstart?

samir: Eng can draft runbook skeleton and quickstart steps for self-hosted/private flows. Need product to provide known failure modes.

anne: I'll write troubleshooting notes and a short quickstart script for hosted API. Samir, create the runbook PR and tag me.

anne: Owners summary:
- pricing doc: miguel
- finops review: lisa
- monitoring smoke: samir
- oncall rota: jo
- runbook: samir
- troubleshooting and landing page: anne
- deployment: deploy-bot (ops)
- post-launch SLO watch: jo

anne: If everyone can ack here we call this closed and hand to ops for GA tomorrow.
miguel: ack
lisa: ack
samir: ack
jo: ack
